top_findings: Canonical apex intermittently returns LiteSpeed 403 to crawler-like and direct requests
SoftwareApplication schema references a hero PNG while rendered page uses WebP
Sitemap currently contains only the homepage
No PageSpeed, CrUX, GSC, or GA4 data was available
Rendered copy contains the minor typo 'stuffyou'
quick_wins: Measure CWV on the stable canonical response

findings.title: Inconsistent canonical-origin access
findings.description: A prescribed crawler request and intermittent direct requests received LiteSpeed 403, while a browser-compatible session received 200 application HTML.
findings.recommendation: Review WAF/LiteSpeed rules and verify stable 200 delivery for users and approved crawlers.

findings.title: Sitemap has one URL
findings.description: The valid sitemap contains only the homepage.
findings.recommendation: Add all intended indexable public URLs and validate their status.

findings.title: Claims need supporting proof
findings.description: The page makes strong first-party claims around privacy, geofencing, offline mode, and accessibility.
findings.recommendation: Add documentation, attributable proof, or independent validation.

findings.title: Minor rendered text defect
findings.description: One H2 renders 'stuffyou' without a space.
findings.recommendation: Correct the source copy and recheck rendered extraction.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication, Offer, and FAQPage markup

findings.title: Schema image URL mismatch
findings.description: SoftwareApplication schema references hero-light.png while the rendered page uses hero-light.webp.
findings.recommendation: Use an existing canonical asset or publish the referenced image.

findings.title: Field and lab CWV unavailable
findings.description: No Google credentials were configured and the crawler renderer was denied.
findings.recommendation: Run Lighthouse/PageSpeed against the stable canonical response and optimize based on LCP, INP, and CLS.

findings.title: Robots allowance does not guarantee retrieval
findings.description: robots.txt allows major AI crawlers, but observed origin 403 responses can prevent access.
findings.recommendation: Test named agents and fix origin/WAF parity.

findings.title: Verify hero payload and theme variants
findings.description: High-resolution hero assets are prominent and light/dark variants are present.
findings.recommendation: Use responsive formats and ensure only the active variant downloads.
